Udbhaṭa
Sabhāpati of Cippaṭa Jayāpīḍa of Kashmir (779-813 A. D.); Rājataraṅgiṇī,

. Writer on Nāṭya an. Alaṅkāra Śāstras. Q. by standard writers Ānandavardhana, Abhinavagupta etc.
--Kāvyālaṁkārasārasaṅgraha. alaṁk.
Edn.. (1) N. S. Press, 1915 with C. by Pratīhārendurāja. (2)

-53 for a transliterated text.
--Kumārasambhava. poem. See the illustrative verses in his above alaṁk. work (KASS) on this continuous theme.
--Nāṭyaśāstravyākhyā, C. on Bharata's N. Ś. q. by Abhinavagupta in his C. on N. Ś. See JOR. Madras, VI. p.. 166-169.
--Bhāmahavivaraṇa, C. on Bh.'s Kāvyālaṅkāra. Views from this cited by Abhinavagupta, Mammaṭa etc. For the recent discovery of frags. most likely of this work found near Kafirkoth in Pakistan, see R. Gnoli, U.'s C. on the Kāvyālaṁkāra of Bh., Ismeo, Rome, 1962.
Q.s of his views on music refer to his C. on N. Ś. of Bharata.
For stray verses of his, see

Udbhaṭa
ācārya of the Kas. Śaiva school. Q. in Tantrālokavyākhyā. Vol. III. Kas. Texts 30. p. 192.

Udbhaṭakavitākaumudī
collection of Skt. verses.
Pt.. with Bengali translation, etc. Calcutta 1890. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 285. 431.

Udbhaṭacandrikā
collection of Skt. verses with Skt. notes an. Bengali transl. by Candramohana Tarkaratna Bhaṭṭācārya.
Pt.. p.. 1. Calcutta, 1880. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 72.

Udbhaṭabhīma
mentioned along with Kālidāsa, Bāṇa, Daṇḍin, Dhanañjaya etc. by Durgasiṁha in Kanarese Pañcatantra, JBBRAS. XXII. p. 12.

Udbhaṭaviveka
alaṁk. C. by Rājānaka Tilaka on U.'s Kāvyālaṁkārasārasaṅgraha,

Udbhaṭaśloka
collection of stray verses; anthology.

Udbhaṭaślokasaṅgraha
anthology. Dacca 441 D. D.(inc.). 2005 K (inc.). (Different collection).

Udbhaṭasiddhasvāmin
alias mudgaragomin Bud.
--Viśeṣa (Viśiṣṭa)stava. Cordier II. p. 30.
--Sarvajñamaheśvarastotra. ib. p. 3.

Udbhaṭārādhya
ancestor of Mallikārjuna or Malleśvara, a. of Kuṇḍadarpaṇa,
. Figures also a. copyist of Bhāratasārasaṅgraha stotra,

Udbhava
śaiva. Upāgama in Vijayāgama. See list in Kāmika.

Udbhavasandeśa
Pannalal Bombay IV. p. 27. Seems to be Uddhavaº.
